blocks.title: Understand how anything works — with evidence
blocks.description: REA inspects desktop applications, native binaries, websites, Android packages and asset archives on your machine. Ask in a conversation; the plugin keeps what each probe proved, so a conclusion can be checked a week later instead of dying in a chat log.

showcase.user_prompt: Understand how Export to PDF works in this app, and show me the evidence.
showcase.assistant_reply: The renderer sends `export:pdf` to the main process, which calls `exportPDF()` in app.asar (src/export.ts:1188) and hands the print job to PDFKit. Confirmed: the IPC handler and the module import. Inferred: the cover page comes from a bundled template — still open, and recorded as an open question on the case. The report with its evidence appendix is in your workspace — ask for it any time with case_report.

items.title: One case per conversation
items.description: The investigation survives the session: target, route, goal, evidence and open questions come back when you continue in that workspace.

items.title: Evidence captured as it happens
items.description: Every REA tool call is recorded with its pointers, size and fingerprint — no reliance on the agent remembering to write things down.

items.title: Confirmed, inferred, unknown
items.description: Findings keep their grade, so a guess never looks like a proof. Gaps stay visible until evidence closes them.

items.title: Engine gaps named up front
items.description: Before the first probe the agent knows which route the target needs and which analysis engine is missing, so it can tell you instead of failing quietly.

items.title: Report and spec on request
items.description: Ask for the result and the agent writes a report with an evidence appendix, or a behaviour spec, into your workspace.

items.title: Investigate from the file tree
items.description: Right-click an app bundle, binary, APK or archive to start the investigation with that path already in context.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: REA's own MCP server ships with the plugin, so nothing needs to be registered by hand. Node.js 22.23.4+, 24.22.1+ or 26.12.1+ is required.

items.title: Name the target and the behaviour
items.description: Ask in a conversation, or right-click a target in the file tree. Say which behaviour you want to understand — one concrete question beats a whole product.

items.title: Leave with evidence, not just an answer
items.description: Ask for the report or the spec when you are done. It lands in your workspace as Markdown, with the open questions still listed.

blocks.content: Only analyse software you own or are authorised to inspect. REA observes statically by default; runtime instrumentation, attaching to a running process or driving an authenticated site needs your explicit go-ahead. Analysis runs on your machine and nothing is uploaded by this plugin.
